notes.title: New Controls & Camera!
notes.notes:
Hey PuckOFF players! 

Controls too tricky? Camera making you dizzy? We heard you, and today, we're excited to release an update that directly addresses your biggest concerns! 

🎮 Alternative Controls: 

We’ve added more classic hockey game controls to make gameplay smoother and offer more ways to play without sacrificing depth. If you’re a fan of old-school hockey games, you should feel right at home! 

🎥 Camera Overhaul: 

No more nausea! For those with a weaker tummy, there’s now an option to play the game from a bird’s-eye view for a smoother experience. Multiplayer can also be played without split-screen. 

🐛 Bug Fixes & General Improvements: 

From small annoyances to bigger issues, we’ve squashed a bunch of bugs and polished things up for an overall better experience. 

 

We’re committed to making PuckOFF the best it can be, and we appreciate your feedback. Jump back in, try the update, and let us know what you think! 

See you on the ice! 🏒
